newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ascom sets Chinese telephone joint venture.
newsitem.headline: Ascom sets Chinese telephone joint venture.

text.p: Swiss telecommunications company Ascom Holding AG has signed a joint venture deal to produce telephones in China as part of an effort to build up its Asian business, chairman Felix Wittlin said.
"For us the Far East is an area of strategic importance that will develop," he told Reuters in an interview at the World Economic Forum in Davos.

"Next week you will hear officially that we have signed a joint-venture agreement with a Chinese partner to produce and sell public telephones in China. A few more things are in the works, but slowly, slowly, slowly," he said.
Wittlin said Ascom was braced for the liberalisation of European telecommunications markets because it had three years of experience in dealing with liberalised markets for hardware.
"We think we can offer new network operators as well a big range (of products), not just telecoms, but other things as well. I am not just talking about Switzerland, but about Europe," he said.
